content.short: Strata is a risk-tranching protocol offering senior and junior yield tranches, starting with USDe.
content.description: Strata is a generalized risk-tranching protocol that splits on-chain and off-chain yield strategies into tranches with different risk and reward. Its first products are Senior USDe (srUSDe), which takes a steadier yield, and Junior USDe (jrUSDe), which takes more risk for a higher one. Plasma's official ecosystem directory lists Strata.
content.meta: Strata splits yield into senior and junior risk tranches, starting with USDe, listed in the Plasma ecosystem.
